title: Would you want AI to remember your entire life?
frame1Text: What if you remembered every conversation?
armature: A device that remembers everything for you also remembers everyone around you: perfect memory is not only yours to choose.

scenes.title: What if you remembered every conversation?
scenes.narration: What if you could remember every conversation you've ever had?

scenes.title: Not with your brain. With AI.
scenes.narration: Not with your brain. With AI.

scenes.label: AI memory wearables
scenes.title: The next generation
scenes.narration: Meet the next generation of AI memory wearables.

scenes.label: Omi · Plaud
scenes.title: Tiny devices
scenes.narration: Tiny devices like Omi and Plaud that you can wear on your shirt, wrist, or around your neck.

scenes.label: record → text → organize
scenes.narration: They record conversations, turn speech into text, and use AI to organize what was said.

scenes.title: What did my boss ask me to do?
scenes.narration: Forgot what your boss asked you to do?

scenes.title: That idea I had over coffee?
scenes.narration: Or that brilliant idea you had over coffee?

scenes.title: Ask your AI memory
scenes.narration: Instead of searching through endless notes, you could ask your AI memory.

scenes.label: always on
scenes.title: Throughout your day
scenes.narration: And some devices are designed to capture conversations throughout your day.
They involve friends, coworkers, and complete strangers.

scenes.title: A much bigger question
scenes.narration: And suddenly, a device that helps you remember everything raises a much bigger question.

scenes.title: If AI could remember your entire life…
scenes.narration: If AI could remember your entire life…

scenes.title: Would you actually want it to?
scenes.narration: Would you actually want it to?

sources: Guion de Enrico (8 nov 2026), basado en un reel compartido; sin cifras en pantalla.
Omi (omi.me) y Plaud (plaud.ai): wearables de grabación y notas con IA; nombres tipografiados, sin logos.
